description: MainActivity.kt defines the MainActivity class for an Android app that generates and displays a color palette with five color tiles. It includes UI setup, palette generation using random HSL values, copying color codes to clipboard, and utility functions for color conversions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the UI and logic for a color palette generator app, including palette creation, color conversions, and clipboard interactions.

methods.name: generateAndApplyPalette
methods.description: Generates a new palette of five random colors using HSL values and applies them to the UI tiles.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the specified text string to the Android system clipboard.

methods.name: hslToColor
methods.description: Converts HSL color components to an ARGB color integer.

methods.name: colorToHex
methods.description: Converts a color integer to its HEX string representation.

methods.name: colorToHsl
methods.description: Converts a color integer to its HSL components (h, s, l).

methods.name: isColorDark
methods.description: Determines if a color is perceived as dark based on luminance.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a short toast message to the user.

methods.name: hueToRgb
methods.description: Helper for hslToColor; converts hue to RGB component.
